title: The Rusted Army
text: Rank on rank of empty armor stands to attention in a long field, rust running down the breastplates like tears. There is not a body in any of it. As you pass, one helm turns slowly to follow you with a sound of grinding iron.

options.label: The Leader takes the best of the armor; its owners are long gone.

outcomes.text: Most of it is past saving, though not all.
As you take it, the ranks close around you.

options.label: Salute them and march past in step, as soldiers to soldiers.

outcomes.text: Every helm turns to watch you go. The field feels honored.

options.label: The strongest orders them to stand down, hoping to be obeyed.

outcomes.text: One by one, all down the field, they kneel.
They do not take orders from the living.
